summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.29/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.29 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 29, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 16¢ higher than a week ago, 9¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.59 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($3.97) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.59).
